title: Web Summit boss Katherine Maher to leave role after three months (The Irish Times, 24 January 2024)
what_it_says: The Irish Times reports that Web Summit's chief executive would step down on 1 March 2024 to become chief executive of NPR, staying on as non-executive chair of the executive board, that she would lead the company through its first conference in Doha, and that the chief events officer was named an executive board member.
